room_name: La salle à manger · The dining room
note: painting repainted to add tall glazed garden doors (to jardin, Le jardin de la fête de famille); alt updated; its 8 word cards recropped

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "BREWT": a big BRUTE of a bulldog, all muscles and growl, hides behind a flower pot from one tiny butterfly: BREWT ≈ BRUTE
note: Une brute is always feminine, even for a man: a brute, a bully, a thug (also an adjective: brut, brute = raw). Insulting when said of someone.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "groh-SEHS": a little boy gently pats his mom's round tummy and whispers 'GROW, SIS!': groh-SEHS ≈ GROW, SIS
note: Pregnancy (pendant la grossesse = during pregnancy). Not from gros: never say it to mean fatness.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "koh-EW": a cow squeezes through a gap in the hedge in a pushing crush of ewes: COW, EWE!: koh-EW ≈ COW, EWE
note: A jostling crowd, a crush (la cohue des soldes = the sales crush); slightly negative: disorderly.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "lay-DEE": a posh LADY in a big flowered hat goes cross-eyed at a LADYbug on her nose: lay-DEE ≈ LADY(bug)
note: Une lady = a refined, elegant lady (English loanword, often a little ironic); also the British title Lady.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "see-tah-DAN": CITY DAN in a shiny suit, briefcase and phone steps right into the muddy puddle by the flower bed: see-tah-DAN ≈ CITY DAN
note: Un citadin, une citadine = a city dweller, a townie; also an adjective, urban (la vie citadine).

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "ah-DOH": a teen in big headphones kneads A DOUGH ball on the picnic table: ah-DOH ≈ A DOUGH
note: Un or une ado: informal for adolescent, a teen (les ados).

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "an-dewl-ZHAHN": grandma winks and slips the toddler another cupcake behind mom's back: so INDULGENT: an-dewl-ZHAHN ≈ INDULGENT
note: Lenient, forgiving (un juge indulgent, une mère indulgente). Not 'self-indulgent'.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "koh-PYEUH": grandpa carries out a COPIOUS mountain of sausages, piled higher than his head: COPY-UH(s): koh-PYEUH ≈ COPIOUS
note: Copious, hearty, generous (un repas copieux); also long, full (des notes copieuses).

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "say-NYOR": a SENIOR grandpa in a potato sack hops past the kids to win the sack race: say-NYOR ≈ SENIOR
note: Un senior = an older person, a senior (polite, marketing word: les seniors); in sport, an adult competitor.

room_name: Le jardin · The garden party
hook: "tee-RUHR": a big uncle pulls the tug-of-war rope so hard it starts to TEAR: TEAR-ER: tee-RUHR ≈ TEAR-ER
note: Someone who pulls; but mostly a shooter, a marksman (un tireur d'élite = a sniper). From tirer = to pull, to shoot.

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "gah-LAHN": a GALLANT boy spreads his jacket over a puddle of spilled punch so a girl can step across: gah-LAHN ≈ GALLANT
note: Gallant, courteous to women; also flirtatious (un rendez-vous galant = a romantic date), even racy in old texts.

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "ehk-strah-vah-GAHN": a lady waltzes past in an EXTRAVAGANT wide blue hat with a little splashing fountain and a toy sailboat on top: ehk-strah-vah-GAHN ≈ EXTRAVAGANT
note: Extravagant, outlandish, over the top; also wildly excessive (des prix extravagants = outrageous prices).

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "vah-nee-TEUH": a vain man twirls his curled mustache in the gilt mirror and ignores the dance: VANITY-UH: vah-nee-TEUH ≈ VANITY-UH
note: Vain, conceited; also (old) futile, empty. Always critical.

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "an-prew-DAHN": a reckless boy swings from the crystal chandelier over the dancers: so IMPRUDENT: an-prew-DAHN ≈ IMPRUDENT
note: Imprudent, reckless, careless (il serait imprudent de... = it would be unwise to...).

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "sew-plee-YAHN": little SUE kneels with clasped hands and PLEADS ON for one more dance: SUE-PLEA-ON: sew-plee-YAHN ≈ SUE PLEA-ON
note: Pleading, imploring (un regard suppliant = a pleading look); also a noun, a supplicant.

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "ah-GAHR": the band's violinist plays on and on, hair on end and dark rings round his staring eyes: HAGGARD: ah-GAHR ≈ HAGGARD
note: Wild-eyed, distraught (des yeux hagards, l'air hagard), more than just tired. The h is not pronounced.

room_name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
hook: "for-tew-NAY": a rich old man with a diamond tie pin pours a FORTUNE in gold coins into a top hat for the band: FORTUNE-AY: for-tew-NAY ≈ FORTUNE-AY
note: Wealthy, well-off (une famille fortunée). Only rarely lucky: fortunate = heureux, chanceux.

room_name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
hook: "pih-toh-REHSK": a girl at her easel copies a PICTURESQUE painting of a windmill village by a river: pih-toh-REHSK ≈ PICTURESQUE
note: Picturesque; also colorful, vivid (un langage pittoresque = colorful language).

room_name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
hook: "ee-LEWSTR": a boy polishes the bust of an ILLUSTRIOUS old scholar in a laurel wreath to a high LUSTER: ee-LEWSTR ≈ (il)LUSTR(ious)
note: Illustrious, famous (un illustre inconnu = a nobody, ironic).

room_name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
hook: "ruh-koh-neh-SAHBL": grandpa stands by his portrait from fifty years ago: the same curly mustache and bow tie make him RECOGNIZ-ABLE at once: ruh-koh-neh-SAHBL ≈ RECOGNIZ-ABLE
note: Recognizable (méconnaissable = unrecognizable).

room_name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
hook: "lewk-SWEUH": a fluffy cat sprawls on a red velvet sofa with gold fringe, pure LUXURY: lewk-SWEUH ≈ LUXURY-UH
note: Luxurious (un hôtel luxueux). Not 'luxuriant' (lush) = luxuriant.

room_name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
hook: "lee-VEED": a visitor goes white as a sheet as grandpa's big portrait tips off the wall toward him: LIVID, but here PALE: lee-VEED ≈ LIVID
note: False friend: livide = deathly pale (or ashen). English livid (furious) = furieux, fou de rage.

room_name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
hook: "ee-rah-SEEBL": a red-faced, cranky guard flaps his cap at a pigeon pecking a picture frame: IRASCIBLE: ee-rah-SEEBL ≈ IRASCIBLE
note: Irascible, quick-tempered, cranky.

room_name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
hook: "tay-TEW": a stubborn pony plants its hooves and refuses to wear the pink TUTU: tay-TEW ≈ TUTU
note: Stubborn, headstrong (têtu comme une mule = stubborn as a mule). From la tête, head.

room_name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
hook: "ay-goh-EEST": a selfish dog lies on a whole heap of balls and won't share a single one: what an EGOIST: ay-goh-EEST ≈ EGOIST
note: Selfish (not only egoist/egotistical); also a noun, un or une égoïste. Critical.

room_name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
hook: "ahn-too-ZYAHST": a puppy leaps sky-high, ears flying, the most ENTHUSIASTIC pup in the show: ahn-too-ZYAHST ≈ ENTHUSIAST
note: Enthusiastic, keen; also a noun, an enthusiast.

room_name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
hook: "PROHN": the instant the girl raises a PRAWN, a PROMPT little terrier is already up on its hind legs for it: PROHN ≈ PRAWN
note: Prompt, quick (un prompt rétablissement = a speedy recovery); prompt à = quick to (prompt à la colère). The mpt sounds like n.

room_name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
hook: "an-dee-fay-RAHN": a cat yawns, bored stiff, as the judge pins a blue ribbon on it: totally INDIFFERENT: an-dee-fay-RAHN ≈ INDIFFERENT
note: Indifferent, not caring (ça m'est indifférent = I don't mind); also unimportant.

room_name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
hook: "pah-SEEF": a basset hound lies flat as a rug while everyone else leaps and runs: so PASSIVE: pah-SEEF ≈ PASSIVE
note: Passive; in grammar, la voix passive = the passive voice; un passif = a debt, liability (accounts).

room_name: Le salon de musique · The music room
hook: "pray-KOS": a tiny girl, feet dangling far above the pedals, plays a whole concerto on the grand piano: so PRECOCIOUS: pray-KOS ≈ PRE-COS(cious)
note: Precocious, advanced for one's age; also early (un hiver précoce = an early winter).

room_name: Le salon de musique · The music room
hook: "ee-nehk-spay-ree-mahn-TAY": a boy holds his first violin upside down and saws the bow on the wrong side: INEXPERIENCED: ee-nehk-spay-ree-mahn-TAY ≈ INEXPERIENCED
note: Inexperienced, untrained (un conducteur inexpérimenté = a novice driver).

room_name: Le salon de musique · The music room
hook: "an-trahn-zee-ZHAHN": a stern teacher with a gray bun holds up the ticking metronome and shakes her head: no exceptions, she's INTRANSIGENT: an-trahn-zee-ZHAHN ≈ INTRANSIGENT
note: Uncompromising, unbending (intransigeant sur les principes); a little critical.

room_name: Le salon de musique · The music room
hook: "ah-vahn-tew-REUH": a boy in an explorer hat and a little rope climbs the golden harp like a mountain: ADVENTURE-UH(s): ah-vahn-tew-REUH ≈ ADVENTURE-UH
note: Adventurous; also risky, hazardous (un projet aventureux).

room_name: Le salon de musique · The music room
hook: "spohn-tah-NAY": a girl suddenly flings her arms wide and bursts out singing: SPONTANEOUS: spohn-tah-NAY ≈ SPONTANE(ous)
note: Spontaneous, natural, unforced (un geste spontané).

room_name: La tente des gâteaux · The bake-sale tent
hook: "kohn-vee-VYAHL": a smiling boy cuts the big chocolate cake so everyone gets a piece: a friendly, CONVIVIAL bake sale: kohn-vee-VYAL ≈ CONVIVIAL
note: Friendly, sociable, warm and welcoming (un repas convivial); in computing also user-friendly.

room_name: La tente des gâteaux · The bake-sale tent
hook: "an-kohn-pah-RAHBL": a towering seven-layer rainbow cake wears the gold ribbon: no other cake can compare, INCOMPARABLE: an-kohn-pah-RAHBL ≈ INCOMPARABLE
note: Incomparable, matchless.

room_name: La tente des gâteaux · The bake-sale tent
hook: "krah-KAHN": a girl bites a big cookie, CRACK, and ON she crunches: so CRUNCHY: krah-KAHN ≈ CRACK-ON
note: Crunchy, crisp; informally also cute, irresistible (il est craquant = he's adorable).

room_name: La tente des gâteaux · The bake-sale tent
hook: "kohn-pah-RAHBL": the judge peers through a magnifying glass at two cherry pies that look exactly the same: totally COMPARABLE: kohn-pah-RAHBL ≈ COMPARABLE
note: Comparable, similar (comparable à = comparable to).
